title: Crazy Rich Asians Hotels: Where It Was Filmed
description: Both Singapore hotels from Crazy Rich Asians are real and bookable: the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark and the colonial-era Raffles Hotel.
h1: Crazy Rich Asians hotels you can actually book
intro: Crazy Rich Asians (2018) turned Singapore into a glittering backdrop, and two of its most memorable settings are real hotels. Here is where the film's big moments took place and how to stay at each.

hotels.note: The 57th-floor SkyPark and its huge rooftop infinity pool set the scene for the film's glamorous engagement party, with the city skyline behind it.
This colonial-era landmark plays the fictional Kingsford Hotel, where Nick and Rachel stay when she isn't welcome at his family's home.

outro: The two hotels are only a short ride apart, so a film-fan weekend can easily include both: a swim at Marina Bay Sands and a drink at Raffles.
